With empty fields, banner reads "Required fields missing — Please fill in: Full Name, Job Title, Email, Professional Summary, Company Name, Position, Start Date, Responsibilities, Degree, School, Graduation Year, Skills" and the "Preview Result" tab is [disabled].
All 14 Resume fields (12 required + Phone, End Date) accepted independent values; DOM read confirms each input retains its own value.

Built-in Markdown "Professional Resume" preview: h1 "Jane Doe", strong "Software Engineer", separator (hr), h2 "Professional Summary"/"Experience"/"Education"/"Skills", h3 "Tech Corp — Senior Developer", emphasis "Jan 2020 - Present"; no unreplaced {{placeholders}}.

issue: Declared-format field (email) accepts invalid value without rejection and preview stays available
actual: The Resume "Email *" input is rendered as type="email" but entering "not-an-email" produced no validation error, cleared the "Required fields missing" banner, enabled the "Preview Result" tab, and the generated preview rendered the literal text "not-an-email" in the contact line.

issue: Markdown-structural special characters are not rejected or neutralized
actual: The app blocks only "< > { } [ ] \ | `" (School field showed "Special characters like < > { } [ ] \ | ` are not allowed" and preview was disabled). But Full Name accepted "# Jane **Doe**" with no error, and the preview rendered it as an h1 containing literal "# Jane" plus a Doe element — the injected Markdown emphasis altered the generated formatting.

evidence: Setting Full Name to whitespace-only re-disabled the "Preview Result" tab and showed "Please fill in: Full Name"; an invalid-character School value also disabled preview. (Email-format validity is not gated — recorded separately under CS-14.)

Clicking "Copy to Clipboard" showed toast "Copied to clipboard! The generated content has been copied."; hooked navigator.clipboard.writeText captured the raw Markdown source (headings ##, **bold**, *italic*, --- separator) matching the template's declared markdown format.
In favorites-only view (3 favorites): searching "weekly" narrowed to only "Weekly Status Report"; clearing search and selecting Category=Resume narrowed to only "Professional Resume".

Clicking heart icons favorited 3 templates (badge 3); header "Favorites" button opened a favorites-only list showing exactly those 3 ("Showing 3 of 6"); clicking the filled heart removed Professional Resume from favorites.

Favoriting flipped the heart button class from bg-muted to bg-primary instantly and header count went 0→1→2→3; unfavoriting flipped it back, dropped the badge to 2, and removed the card from the favorites list (count "Showing 0 of 6", "No favorites yet").

Category=Resume → 1 result (Professional Resume); Scenario=Academic → "Showing 1 of 6" (Academic Research Summary). Sorts: Most Popular = uses desc; Recently Updated = 12-05,12-01,11-28,11-15,10-20,09-30; Oldest First = createdAt asc (Email 01-08 → Academic 05-12, matches stored data); Alphabetical = Academic…, Meeting…, Professional Email, Professional Resume, Project Proposal, Weekly…

Search text, category, scenario, favorites-only toggle and sort selection all updated card list and the "Showing X of 6 templates" counter in place; URL stayed http://localhost:6089/ with no page navigation/reload throughout.

Typing "re" (2 chars) showed a live suggestion dropdown (Professional Resume, Responsibilities, Degree, Weekly Status Report, In Progress); clicking "Professional Resume" filled the search box with that text and narrowed results to 1 card ("Showing 1 of 6 templates").

actual: Typing "resme" (typo for "resume") returned "No templates found" / "Showing 0 of 6 templates" with no suggestion dropdown. Same for "meetng" (typo for "meeting") — 0 results and no suggestions. Only exact substring matches work.

evidence: Submitted "QA Test Checklist" with title, author (QA Bot), description, category (Other), scenario (Business), Markdown content and one defined field ("Project Name" → {{project_name}}); dialog closed and library grew from 6 to 7.
Immediately after submission (no reload, URL unchanged) the grid showed the new "QA Test Checklist" card and the counter changed from "Showing 6 of 6 templates" to "Showing 7 of 7 templates".

issue: No placeholder/field mapping validation; previews contain unresolved placeholders
actual: Submitted a custom template whose content had {{projectName}}, {{testerName}}, {{summary}} while the only declared field was "Project Name" (auto-keyed {{project_name}}). Submission was accepted with no error. Using the template, the preview rendered literally "QA Report: {{projectName}} / Tester: {{testerName}} / Summary {{summary}}" — three unresolved placeholders — and the declared field's value never appeared.

evidence: The submitted "QA Test Checklist" card appears in the library (7 of 7) with author "QA Bot", category Other, scenario Business, 0 uses; clicking "Use Template" opened its fill form and Preview tab rendered output.

issue: Duplicate field labels are neither rejected nor disambiguated; duplicated fields are not independently fillable
actual: Adding a second field labeled "Team Name" was accepted (both shown as {{team_name}}) and the template submitted without warning. Stored fields contain two entries with identical id "team_name". In the use form, typing "Platform" into the first Team Name input simultaneously set the fourth input (placeholder "Duplicate label") to "Platform" — they share one state key. React console errors were also emitted after the interaction.

evidence: Plain-text custom template "Daily Standup Note" previewed inside a <pre> with indentation preserved and no Markdown interpretation: "Standup for Platform /   Yesterday: Shipped login fix /   Today: Review PRs / * not a bullet in plain text *". Markdown template (Professional Resume) rendered headings/strong/em/hr after substitution (see FT-8).

Submission blocked (dialog stayed open, stored library count unchanged) for: fully empty form; all fields filled but zero defined fields; whitespace-only title; whitespace-only content; whitespace-only author; whitespace-only description. Each blocked case left library at 8 templates.

After reloading http://localhost:6089/, the library shows "Showing 8 of 8 templates" including both custom templates ("Daily Standup Note", "QA Test Checklist"), and the Favorites badge still reads 2 with Weekly Status Report and Academic Research Summary hearts still active (persisted via localStorage keys template-library / template-favorites).
